self_hosted_checkout.title: Self-Hosted Checkout
self_hosted_checkout.desc: Deploy the open-source checkout frontend on your own domain with Docker—no code changes required.
self_hosted_checkout.detail_desc: Run the payment page at checkout.yourdomain.com instead of a third-party URL. FilixPay handles payment logic; you control branding, hosting, and access logs.

points.0: Pull the official GHCR image and configure via environment variables only
points.1: Use Developer Center credentials (Client ID / Secret) to connect to FilixPay APIs
points.2: Apache-2.0 open source—audit the frontend; core risk and channel logic stays on FilixPay

checkout_deployment.title: Self-Hosted Checkout Deployment
checkout_deployment.desc: For merchants who want the payment page on their own domain and infrastructure—not FilixPay's hosted checkout. Deploy the open-source filix-checkout frontend with Docker; no frontend code changes needed.

brand.title: Your Domain, Your Brand
brand.desc: Serve checkout at checkout.yourdomain.com so customers see your brand in the address bar—helping reduce drop-off and build trust.

compliance.title: Clear Data Boundaries
compliance.desc: Checkout frontend code, access logs, and deployment environment stay on your servers—easier for internal compliance and audit requirements.

open_source.title: Open Source & Auditable
open_source.desc: Apache-2.0 licensed Next.js checkout. Review the code yourself; payment core logic remains on FilixPay backend with the same security boundary.

low_cost.title: Low Integration Overhead
low_cost.desc: No business logic changes—configure API credentials and URLs via environment file, pull the Docker image, and go live.

credentials.title: 1. Get API Credentials
credentials.desc: Create FILIXPAY_BACKEND_CLIENT_ID and FILIXPAY_BACKEND_CLIENT_SECRET in FilixPay Developer Center.

docker.title: 2. Deploy with Docker
docker.desc: Pull ghcr.io/filixpay/filix-checkout, mount your env file, and run on port 3001. Pin a version tag for production.

domain.title: 3. Bind Your Domain
domain.desc: Expose checkout.example.com via Nginx or Caddy with HTTPS. Set NEXTAUTH_URL to match the public URL.

checkout_deployment.note: This is a lightweight self-hosted checkout frontend—not the full FilixPay private deployment (PostgreSQL, Redis, Keycloak stack). See the comparison on the Private Deployment page.
